title: St. Vith breaks musical boundaries with new single “North Of Your Border”
htmlContent:
With "North Of Your Border," St. Vith is excitingly breaking new ground. This single introduces a fresh chapter for the band, showcasing their bass player and singer/songwriter, Oliver Burdo, as the driving force behind this project.

The song was recorded at their creative hub, Evil Bubble Headquarters, and feels like a real expression of artistic freedom. You can hear the personal touch in the music, as each member of the band contributed their unique ideas before coming together to create something special. The result is a track that stays true to St. Vith's recognizable sound while exploring new and adventurous directions.

https://open.spotify.com/album/2cPj1O1s02BTqtpbrYt52z?si=RNWqzlv1Rnuox_4izXy6vQ

Burdo's role as bassist and songwriter brings a deep, emotional quality to the song. His musical instincts help craft a sound that feels close. While this track takes a different approach than what fans are used to, it still captures the energetic spirit that has always been a part of their music. "North Of Your Border" shows that St. Vith is ready to grow, try new things, and push boundaries for themselves and their listeners.
